description: Allwinner SoCs in FEL, the boot ROM's USB download mode: Atlas runs an eGON SPL in SRAM through the FEL thunk, then a legacy U-Boot image, and writes the storage. No vendor tool at run time (written from sunxi-tools). Untested on a board.
entry: Hold its FEL (download) key, or short its FEL pads, and connect the board's USB port to this computer.
Power the board on, then release the key or remove the short.
The board appears as an Allwinner FEL device (1f3a:<pid>).

stages: fel: the boot ROM answers the FEL version and memory requests
spl: an eGON SPL is written into SRAM, run through the FEL thunk and read back
uboot: the SPL, then a legacy U-Boot image is written and executed
confirm: the storage is written from the image and read back
flash.fel_image: eGON SPL then legacy U-Boot (u-boot-sunxi-with-spl form); the board record names the file. UNCONFIRMED for the A733.

todo: The A733's FEL USB id is 1f3a:efe8: Radxa's PhoenixSuit driver instructions name it (Cubie A7A and A7Z flashing pages). Confirm with lsusb on a board.
UNCONFIRMED: sram stays null until an SoC's SRAM layout is sourced (atlas-socflash fel/layout.rs: a record gives one).
Untested on an A733: checked against the mock board and replay vectors only.
